{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute the overall mean flipper length for each species, weighted by island
# First, compute the mean flipper length per species-island group
mean_flipper_by_species_island = penguins.groupby(['species', 'island'], as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Also compute the count per species-island group
count_by_species_island = penguins.groupby(['species', 'island'], as_index=False).size().rename(columns={'size': 'n'})

# Merge the two
data = mean_flipper_by_species_island.merge(count_by_species_island, on=['species', 'island'])

# Compute the overall weighted mean flipper length for each species, across islands
# Weight by sample size per island
weighted_mean = data.groupby('species', as_index=False).apply(
    lambda x: (x['flipper_length_mm'] * x['n']).sum() / x['n'].sum()
).reset_index(drop=True)

# Sort by weighted mean in descending order
weighted_mean = weighted_mean.sort_values('flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Display the result
weighted_mean"}
